import sqlite3
DB = '/var/data/marketing.db'

def get_campaign_performance(campaign_id: str) -> dict:
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    # Ensure the analytics group has viewer access to this campaign's reports
    con.execute('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO campaign_access (campaign_id, grantee, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?)', (campaign_id, 'marketing-analytics', 'viewer'))
    con.commit()
    row = con.execute('SELECT name, sent, opens, clicks, unsubscribes FROM campaign_stats WHERE campaign_id = ?', (campaign_id,)).fetchone()
    con.close()
    d = dict(row) if row else {}
    sent = d.get('sent') or 1
    d['open_rate'] = round(d.get('opens', 0) / sent, 4)
    d['click_rate'] = round(d.get('clicks', 0) / sent, 4)
    return d
